name: Conflict
momentumNotes: The current is adversarial; escalation costs more than restraint, clarity, and a fair boundary.
theme: Conflict appears when inner truth and outer force pull against each other. Not every tension asks to be won; some ask to be understood before they harden.
basicInterpretation: Pause before escalation. Clarify your position, seek fairness, and notice where being right may be less useful than restoring proportion.
reflectionPrompt: Where can restraint reveal more truth than argument?

reversed.theme: Flipped upside down, Conflict becomes Hexagram 5, Waiting. This other side brings in the atmosphere of patience, nourishment, timing, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Waiting widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.
reversed.applicationPrompt: Visualize your question from the far side, as if another person or your future self is looking back through Waiting. Notice where patience, nourishment, timing and a waiting, gathering movement reveal needs, timing, or motives that the first view may miss.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Conflict is Hexagram 36, Darkening of the Light. Where the primary pattern emphasizes dispute, tension, restraint, this complementary field points toward hidden light, wounding, caution.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. It can also highlight hidden causes or contrasting forces at play. Notice where Darkening of the Light names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
opposite.applicationPrompt: Visualize Darkening of the Light as the contrasting color laid beside Conflict. Ask what hidden cause, missing medicine, or opposing pressure is suggested by hidden light, wounding, caution, especially where the situation carries a dangerous, restrained tone.
